scope: explicit post-fit Gaussian ML ultrametric-tree phylo_rr workflow; generic engine remains closed
command: GLLVM_S3B_LIVE_ADAPTER_TESTS=1 GLLVM_DESTINATION_B_PROJECT=<isolated GLLVM.jl worktree> GLLVM_S3B_JULIA_HOME=<Julia 1.10 executable> Rscript --vanilla -e "devtools::test(filter = 'julia-phylo-rr-bridge', reporter = 'summary')"

public_cell.native_formula: value ~ 0 + trait + phylo_latent(species, d = 1, unique = FALSE)

public_contract.intervals: only stored Julia transformed-Wald endpoints whose object and target methods pass the fail-closed gate
public_contract.logLik: df = length(Julia parameters); nobs = n_traits * n_observations
public_contract.source_health: native optimizer convergence exactly zero and finite parameter vector required

negative_controls: generic engine = julia still rejects phylo_rr
dense vcv and pedigree rejected by the public Tree wrapper
extra fixed effects rejected before Julia
unconverged, fractional, or malformed native optimizer metadata rejected
profile-labelled, non-transformed-Wald, or malformed stored endpoints rejected

review.verdict: no P0 after re-review; P1 malformed-input gaps repaired and re-tested

exclusions: no dense-vcv or pedigree public workflow
no prediction, residuals, simulation, vcov, recovery, or coverage claim
